```{python}
#| label: fig-singular-values
#| fig-cap: "lung mappings separability"

# import numpy as np
# import pandas as pd



import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go

data = pd.read_csv("Figures/Figure_Singular_values.csv")

x = data['N']
y_RL = data['SV_RL']
y_LL = data['SV_LL']
y_full_RL = data['SV_full_RL']
y_full_LL = data['SV_full_LL']

fig = go.Figure()
color_RL = 'first_color'    # Corresponds to 'BleuLMS' in TikZ
color_LL = 'second_color'   # Corresponds to 'RougeLMS' in TikZ

# Add a trace with a legend name
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(   x=x, 
                            y=y_RL, 
                            mode='lines', 
                            name='Right lung',  
                             line=dict(
                        color='#01426a',
                        width=2.5 )
                    ))

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(   x=x, 
                            y=y_LL, 
                            mode='lines', 
                            name='Left lung',  
                             line=dict(
                        color='#CE0037',
                        width=2.5 )
                    ))

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(   x=x, 
                            y=y_full_RL, 
                            mode='lines', 
                            name='RL full kinematics',  
                             line=dict(
                        color='#01426a',
                        width=2.5,
                        dash= 'dot' )
                    ))

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(   x=x, 
                            y=y_full_LL, 
                            mode='lines', 
                            name='LL full kinematics',  
                             line=dict(
                        color='#CE0037',
                        width=2.5,
                        dash= 'dot' )
                    ))

fig.update_layout(
        plot_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)',  # Remove background color
    width=450, 
    height=255,  
    # title='Singular values decay',
    xaxis=dict(title='Modes',
        showgrid=True,
        gridcolor='lightgray'),
    yaxis=dict(
        title='Singular values',

        showgrid=True,
        gridcolor='lightgray'
    ),

    font=dict(
        size=14,  
)   

)

fig.update_yaxes(type="log")

fig.show()



```
